product.description:
Poetry of the English Renaissance, 1509–1660

A substantial vintage poetry anthology selected from early editions and manuscripts, edited by J. William Hebel and Hoyt H. Hudson. This F. S. Crofts hardcover is the September 1932 third printing.

Condition

Acceptable vintage condition. No dust jacket. Heavy scratches, scuffs, pale spots and staining on the cloth boards; faded spine lettering and worn gilt emblem. Corners and spine ends are worn and frayed, with small holes in the cloth near a joint. Pages and endpapers show foxing and age toning. A former owner’s handwritten name and date and handwritten study notes appear on the endpapers. Preliminary pages have corner creasing, and the hinges show wear. Not inspected page by page; binding strength and interior completeness have not been fully checked. Please review all eight photographs.

Details

  • Title: Poetry of the English Renaissance, 1509–1660
  • Editors: J. William Hebel, Cornell University, and Hoyt H. Hudson, Princeton University
  • Publisher: F. S. Crofts & Co., New York
  • Third printing, September 1932; title page dated 1932; copyright 1929
  • English-language cloth hardcover with gilt front emblem; printed in the United States
  • Approximately 9 × 6¼ × 2 inches; book-only weight 2 lb 10.9 oz

Included

One hardcover book. No dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
